stage: Source-metadata and estimand contract created BEFORE animal displacement magnitudes opened for the three southern-source archives. Earlier northern outcomes already known; comparison is hypothesis-led exploratory rather than blinded confirmation.
sampling_frame: Three preregistered Southern Hemisphere wild terrestrial mammals enumerated from the complete 437-package Movebank Data Repository catalog: Etosha African elephants, southern Brazil lowland tapirs, and Etosha black-backed jackals. No source added after outcome access.

astronomical_calendar: Southern midwinter-to-midwinter solar cycle y: rising daylength after June 21 in year y until before December 21 y; falling daylength after December 21 y until before June 21 in y+1. Compare opposite summer-solstice branches, do not match northern June-summer convention to southern winter.
measurement: Per individual, time-sort original UTC GPS fixes. Consecutive interval 0.5–2 h, both endpoint/midpoint local mean-solar day or night on same solar local date, great-circle km / elapsed time, exclude intervals exceeding 60 km/hour; >=3 such steps in both day and night per date. No interpolation. Distinct observation time is not an activity-duration estimate.
pairing: Within individual and southern solar-year only, northern-style unchanged <=5-min astronomical daylength caliper evaluated at source-data daily mean latitude, dates separated >=30 days; match date pairs greedily by minimum mismatch with no date re-use; day and night step-count falling/rising ratios each 0.5..2; >=10 pairs per individual-solar-year. Drop day-pairs if source lacks observation coverage, no effect-based rescues.
primary_endpoint: mean across date pairs and cycles, equal cycles within individual, equal individuals per source, of falling-minus-rising [(log1p median night speed km/h) - (log1p median day speed km/h)].
secondary: Absolute falling-minus-rising daytime and nighttime log1p median GPS speed components; individual counts positive/negative/zero, qualified years and pairs.
uncertainty: 2000 animal-cluster bootstrap replicates with deterministic seed 20261019, percentile interval; only descriptive within source. Report effect only if >=5 admitted individuals.
nonclaims: Not true continuous activity, animal energetic expenditure, environmental mediation, thermal causality, relative human-clock entrainment, phylogenetic generality, or a globally representative sample. Sources within Etosha may be from different years and are not synchronized interaction evidence.
output_policy: Keep original source files, precise coordinates, event timestamps, per-individual IDs and per-individual effects off the repository and out of artifacts. Output grouped descriptive estimates, source checksum QA, gate failures and counts only.
